solana.name: Solana
solana.protect: a wallet with MEV protection (Jito-protected / private transactions) and a 1% slippage limit

bsc.name: BNB Chain

ethereum.name: Ethereum

robinhood.name: Robinhood Chain
robinhood.protect: a 1% slippage limit (Robinhood Chain orders transactions first-come, first-served, so classic sandwiches are harder, but not impossible)
